def buildDisplay(row):
	 	display = []
		display.append(row['scheduleBlockName'] or row['modeName'])
		if row['modeName'] == 'Production':
			if row['workOrderName'] is not None: 
				display.append("%s %s "%(row['workOrderTitle'], row['workOrderStatusName']))
				if row['dueDate']: display.append("Due on %s"%(system.date.format(row['dueDate'], "yy-MM-dd")))
			itemDescription = "- %s"%row['itemDescription'] if row['itemDescription'] else ''
			if row['itemName'] is not None: display.append("%s %s"%(row['itemName'], itemDescription))
			scheduledQty = row['scheduledQty'] or ''
			units = row['itemUnitName'] or row['outfeedUnits'] or 'units'
			if scheduledQty != '': display.append("{:,} {}".format(int(row['scheduledQty']), units))
		
		if row['assetPath'] is not None: display.append(system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(row['assetPath'], {'drop':self.custom.assetInfo.assetPath}))
		if row['notes'] is not None: display.append(row['notes'])
		if row['rruleStr']:
			if display: display[0] = u'🕓 ' + display[0]
			else: display.append(u'🕓 ')
		return '\n'.join(display)

	scheduleData = dict(value)
	events = []	
	if len(scheduleData) == 0: return events
	
	for k,v in scheduleData.items():	
		events.append({
			"id": str(v['uuid']),
			"title": buildDisplay(v),
			"name": v['scheduleBlockName'],
			"assetPath": v['assetPath'],
			"start": v['start'],
			"end": v['end'],
			"eventType": v['modeName'],
			"modeId": v['modeId'],
			"workOrder": v['workOrderName'],
			"workOrderTitle": v['workOrderTitle'],
			"workOrderId": v['workOrderId'],
			"workOrderStatusId": v['workOrderStatusId'],
			"workOrderStatusName": v['workOrderStatusName'],
			"statusColor": v['statusColor'],
			"productCode": v['itemId'],
			"itemId": v['itemId'],
			"scheduledQty": v['scheduledQty'],
			"notes": v['notes'],
			"eventColor": v['color'],
			"backgroundColor": v['color'],
			"textColor": system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(v['color']),
			"borderColor": v['color'],
			"eventId": v['scheduleBlockId'],
			"rruleStr": v['rruleStr'],
			"isActive": v['isActive'],
			"dueDate": v['dueDate']
		})

	return events

def applyVar(color):
		if '--kc' in color: return 'var(%s)'%color
		return color
		
	def reassignColor(event):
		'''
		If order status isActive, check to see if current time is after due date and if actualQty < reqdQty otherwise take the color from mode or item
		'''
		scheduleConfig = self.view.custom.scheduleConfig
		if event['workOrderId'] is not None and scheduleConfig.has_key('colorScheduleEventsByOrderStatus') and scheduleConfig['colorScheduleEventsByOrderStatus'] is not None:
			orderOverdue = False

			if event['isActive']:
				data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderId': event['workOrderId'], 'ignoreActualQty': False}))
				if len(data):
					workOrderInfo = data[0]
					if workOrderInfo['dueDate'] and workOrderInfo['actualQty'] < workOrderInfo['reqdQty'] and system.date.isAfter(system.date.now(), workOrderInfo['dueDate']): orderOverdue = True
			
			if orderOverdue: 
				event['title'] = 'OVERDUE\n' + event['title']
				eventColor = '#FF0000'
			else:
				eventColor = event['eventColor']
		
			event['backgroundColor'] = eventColor if not selected else '#D5D5D5'
			event['borderColor'] = eventColor
			event['textColor'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(eventColor) if not selected else '#00FF00'
			
		return event
		
	events = []
	for event in value['events']:
		event = dict(event)
		selected = True if event['id'] in value['selectedUUIDs'] else False
		if value['colorCodeOrders']: 
			event = reassignColor(event)
		else:
			event["backgroundColor"] = event['eventColor'] if not selected else (event['eventColor'] or '#D5D5D5') + '55'
			event["textColor"] = system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(str(event['eventColor'] or '#D5D5D5')) if not selected else '#00FF00'
			event["borderColor"] = event['eventColor'] if not selected else '#000000'

		events.append(event)
	
	return events

customMethods.name: addEvent
customMethods.script:
'''
		eventInfo (dict)
		- scheduleBlockInfo (dict)
		- start (string): i.e '2025-01-01 06:00:00'
		- end (string): i.e '2025-01-01 14:00:00'
	'''

	system.perspective.print("addEvent() called for %s to %s "%(eventInfo['start'], eventInfo['end']))
	
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True
	scheduleConfig = self.view.custom.scheduleConfig
	assetScheduleConfig = self.view.custom.assetScheduleConfig
	scheduleConfig = {'shiftTimeOnly': assetScheduleConfig.shiftTimeOnly, 'intelligentScheduling': assetScheduleConfig.intelligentScheduling}
	
	startDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['start'])
	endDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['end'])	

	scheduleBlock = eventInfo['scheduleBlockInfo']
	scheduleBlock['timezone'] = self.view.custom.assetInfo.timeZone	
	scheduleBlock['startDate'] = system.date.parse(eventInfo['start'])
	scheduleBlock['endDate'] = system.date.parse(eventInfo['end'])

	timezone = self.view.custom.assetInfo.timeZone
	newDateOffSetMins = system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate)
	scheduleBlock['startDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, - newDateOffSetMins)	
	scheduleBlock['endDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, - system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, endDate))
	
	if not self.checkEventUpdate(scheduleBlock['startDate']): return	#Can't edit this event

	rangeStart = system.date.addDays(scheduleBlock['startDate'],-1)
	rangeEnd = system.date.addWeeks(rangeStart, 1)
		
	scheduleTimes, scheduleOverlap, overlappingScheduleBlocks = system.kanoa.schedule.checkForScheduleOverlap(scheduleBlock, assetScheduleConfig, rangeStart, rangeEnd)
	system.perspective.print("checkForScheduleOverlap() returned %s %s %s"%(scheduleTimes, scheduleOverlap, overlappingScheduleBlocks))
		
	if scheduleOverlap: self.getUserSchedulingChoice(scheduleBlock)
	else:
		system.perspective.print('here')
		assetScheduleConfig['intelligentScheduling'] = False
		scheduleBlockIds, msg = self.scheduleOperation(scheduleBlock, assetScheduleConfig, 'default')
		system.perspective.print('scheduleBlockIds: %s'%scheduleBlockIds)
		scheduleBlocks = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.schedule.getScheduleBlocks({'scheduleBlockIdList': scheduleBlockIds}))
		importLogs = ['Order has been scheduled from %s to %s'%(row['start'], row['end']) for row in scheduleBlocks if row['workOrderId']]
		if len(importLogs): system.perspective.openPopup('scheduleLogs', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/loggingPopup', params={'popupId': 'scheduleLogs', 'logs': importLogs}, draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, title='Order Schedule Information')
		

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False

	return

customMethods.name: deleteEvents
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteEvents() called with changeType %s"%changeType)
	clientTZOffsetHrs = self.session.props.device.timezone.utcOffset
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True
	selectedIds = self.view.custom.calendar.selection.ids
	deletedCount = 0
	workOrderIds = []

	for k, v in self.view.custom.schedule.data.items():
		if k not in selectedIds: continue
		
		scheduleBlock = v
		if scheduleBlock['rruleStr'] and changeType is None:
			self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent = scheduleBlock
			system.perspective.openPopup('recurringEventOptions', 'kanoa/scheduler/embedded/recurringEventChange', {'action': 'deleteSelectedEvents'}, 'Recurring Event Change')
			return
		elif changeType == 'This event':			
			system.kanoa.schedule.addScheduleBlockException(scheduleBlock['scheduleBlockId'], scheduleBlock['startDate'], userId)
			deletedCount += 1
		elif changeType == 'This and following events':
			rruleStr = scheduleBlock['rruleStr']
			exceptionDate = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.parse(scheduleBlock['start']), -1)
			if "UNTIL=" in rruleStr or "COUNT=" in rruleStr: rruleStr = ";".join(rruleStr.split(';')[:-1])
			rruleStr += ";UNTIL=" + system.kanoa.utilities.javaDateToPython(exceptionDate).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')			
			system.kanoa.schedule.updateScheduleBlockField(scheduleBlock['scheduleBlockId'], 'rruleStr', rruleStr, userId)
			deletedCount += 1
		else:
			system.kanoa.schedule.deleteScheduleBlock(scheduleBlock['scheduleBlockId'], userId)
			deletedCount += 1
			if scheduleBlock['workOrderId']: workOrderIds.append(scheduleBlock['workOrderId'])
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshEvents', {'assetPath': self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath})
	if deletedCount: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', '%s Scheduled %s deleted'%(deletedCount, 'event' if deletedCount==0 else 'events'))
		system.kanoa.schedule.updateClientsScheduleChange(self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath)
		
		for workOrderId in list(set(workOrderIds)):
			woInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'ignoreActualQty': True}),0)
			if woInfo['workOrderStatusName'] == 'Scheduled' and (woInfo['schedQty'] or 0) == 0: 
				workOrderStatusId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('workOrderStatusId', system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrderStates({'workOrderStatusName': 'Released'}))
				system.perspective.print("Setting workorder status back to Released")
				system.kanoa.order.updateProductionOrderField(woInfo['workOrderId'], 'workOrderStatusId', workOrderStatusId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshOrders', {})	#forces the order event selector to update itself

	else: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarnToast', 'No Scheduled events deleted')
		
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
	
	return

customMethods.name: adjustEvent
customMethods.script:
'''
		eventInfo (dict)
		- scheduleBlockInfo (dict)
		- changeType (string)
		- start (string): i.e '2025-01-01 06:00:00'
		- end (string): i.e '2025-01-01 14:00:00'
	'''

	system.perspective.print("adjustEvent() called with %s %s to %s. ChangeType %s"%(eventInfo['scheduleBlockInfo']['uuid'], eventInfo['start'], eventInfo['end'], eventInfo['changeType']))
	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = True
	assetScheduleConfig = self.view.custom.assetScheduleConfig	
	scheduleConfig = {'shiftTimeOnly': assetScheduleConfig.shiftTimeOnly, 'intelligentScheduling': assetScheduleConfig.intelligentScheduling}	
	
	scheduleBlockInfo = dict(eventInfo['scheduleBlockInfo'])
	changeType = eventInfo['changeType']
	startDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['start'])
	endDate = system.date.parse(eventInfo['end'])
		
	if scheduleBlockInfo is None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', "We couldn't find the dropped schedule event. we've either lost it or the calendar has created a 'ghost event'. Navigate away and then back to this screen to clear it. BIJC is working on a fix for this")
		return	

	if not self.checkEventUpdate(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate']): return	#Can't edit this event
	
	if scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr'] and changeType is None:
		self.view.custom.schedule.selected.adjustEvent = {'scheduleBlockInfo': scheduleBlockInfo, 'start': eventInfo['start'], 'end': eventInfo['end']}
		system.perspective.openPopup('recurringEventOptions', view = 'kanoa/scheduler/embedded/recurringEventChange', params={'action': 'dropEvent'}, title = 'Recurring Event Change')
		self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
		return

	timezone = self.view.custom.assetInfo.timeZone
	newDateOffSetMins = system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, startDate)
	scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, - newDateOffSetMins)	
	scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'] = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, - system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, endDate))
	scheduleBlockId = scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockId']
	rruleStr = scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr']
		
	if rruleStr is None:
		rangeStart = system.date.addDays(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'],-1)
		rangeEnd = system.date.addWeeks(rangeStart, 1)
		scheduleTimes, scheduleOverlap, overlappingScheduleBlocks = system.kanoa.schedule.checkForScheduleOverlap(scheduleBlockInfo, scheduleConfig, rangeStart, rangeEnd)
		if scheduleOverlap: 
			self.getUserSchedulingChoice(scheduleBlockInfo)
			return

		scheduleConfig['intelligentScheduling'] = False
		self.scheduleOperation(scheduleBlockInfo, scheduleConfig, 'default')
		
	else: #From this point on we have received the recurring option, so now we know what to do with the scheduleBlock	
		if changeType == 'This event':
			system.kanoa.schedule.addScheduleBlockException(scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockId'], scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
			scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr'] = None
			system.kanoa.schedule.addScheduleBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		elif changeType == 'This and following events':
			if "UNTIL=" in rruleStr or "COUNT=" in rruleStr: rruleStr = ";".join(rruleStr.split(';')[:-1])
			
			from datetime import datetime
			dt = datetime.strptime(scheduleBlockInfo['start'], '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') # Parse the string into a datetime object
			dt = dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0) # Modify the time to midnight
			rruleStr += ";UNTIL=" + dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') # Convert back to the required format			
			
			system.kanoa.schedule.updateScheduleBlockField(scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockId'], 'rruleStr', rruleStr, self.view.custom.security.userId)
			system.kanoa.schedule.addScheduleBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		elif changeType == 'All events':	
			scheduleBlockStartingDate = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('startDate', system.kanoa.schedule.getScheduleBlocks({'scheduleBlockId': scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockId']}))
			oldDateOffSetMins = system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, scheduleBlockStartingDate)	#Could be this block was created at a different DST time.
			delta = system.date.daysBetween(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'], system.date.midnight(scheduleBlockStartingDate))
			if delta > 0: delta = 0	#We are only looking for the first event instance in case the user selected say the third instance			
			scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addDays(system.date.addMinutes(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate'], newDateOffSetMins - oldDateOffSetMins), delta)
			scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'] = system.date.addDays(system.date.addMinutes(scheduleBlockInfo['endDate'], newDateOffSetMins - oldDateOffSetMins), delta)			
			delta = system.date.daysBetween(system.date.midnight(scheduleBlockInfo['startDate']), system.date.midnight(scheduleBlockStartingDate))
			system.kanoa.schedule.updateScheduleBlock(scheduleBlockInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)

		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshEvents', {'assetPath': self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath})
		system.kanoa.schedule.updateClientsScheduleChange(self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Schedule event updated')

	self.view.custom.schedule.updateInProgress = False
	
	return

customMethods.script:
def getWorkOrderId(text):
		import re
	
		match = re.search(r'\(ID\s*(\d+)\)', text)
		return int(match.group(1)) if match else None

	event = dict(event)
	debug = False
	system.perspective.print("addWorkOrder() called with %s"%event)
	start = event['startDate']
	end = event['endDate'] #This is usually null on a work order being dragged over from the event selector
	
	if not self.view.custom.security.userCRUD.scheduleOperations.enabled and not self.view.custom.security.userCRUD.isGatewayAdmin:
		msg = "Sorry, you don't have rights to schedule operations on this asset"
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', msg)
		return

	assetInfo = self.view.custom.assetInfo
	if assetInfo['assetTypeName'].upper() != 'LINE':
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Please select line level asset, to drop work order.')
		return
	
	eventList = event['title'].split('\n')
	workOrderId = getWorkOrderId(event['title'])
	woInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'ignoreActualQty': False}),0)
	remainingQty = max(0, (woInfo['reqdQty'] or 0.0) - (woInfo['schedQty'] or 0.0) - (woInfo['actualQty'] or 0.0))
	
	if event['qtySelected'] == False or remainingQty <= 0.0 and not event.has_key('selectedQty'):
		event['skipQtySelect'] = False
		system.perspective.openPopup('workOrderQtySelect', 'kanoa/scheduler/embedded/confirmOrderQuantity', params={'value': {'eventInfo': event, 'woInfo': woInfo, 'assetInfo': assetInfo}}, title='Set Work Order Quantity')
		return
		
	if max(0, (woInfo['reqdQty'] or 0.0) - (woInfo['schedQty'] or 0.0) - (woInfo['actualQty'] or 0.0)) == 1.0:
		event['qtySelected'] = True
		event['selectedQty'] = 1.0
	
	if event.has_key('skipQtySelect') and event['skipQtySelect']:
		event['qtySelected'] = True
		event['selectedQty'] = remainingQty
		
	
#	system.perspective.print('selectedQty: %s'%event['selectedQty'])
	# Calculate event duration
	itemInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('metaDataValue', system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrderMetaData({'workOrderId': woInfo['workOrderId'], 'metaDataName': 'orderScheduleRateInfo'}))
	if itemInfo: 
		itemInfo = system.util.jsonDecode(itemInfo)
		if debug: log.info('work order contains metaData of %s'%itemInfo)
		msg = "Using rate information set for this order."
	else:
#		system.perspective.print('assetInfo: %s'%assetInfo)
		itemInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'assetPath': assetInfo['assetPath'], 'itemId':woInfo['itemId']}),0)
		if debug: log.info('work order using item rates of %s'%itemInfo)
	
	# New code to schedule production order duration based on shift and crew size
	eventStart = system.date.parse(start)
	assetScheduleConfig = self.view.custom.assetScheduleConfig
	scheduleConfig = {'shiftTimeOnly': assetScheduleConfig.shiftTimeOnly, 'intelligentScheduling': assetScheduleConfig.intelligentScheduling}

#	system.perspective.print('calcEventDuration() called with %s, %s, %s %s'%(assetInfo['assetId'], eventStart, event['selectedQty'], itemInfo))
	if not itemInfo.has_key('packageCount'): itemInfo['packageCount'] = 1.0
	eventEnd, msg, durationCalcLogs = system.kanoa.schedule.calcEventDuration(assetInfo['assetId'], eventStart, event['selectedQty'], itemInfo)
#	system.perspective.print("calcEventDuration() returned %s %s %s"%(eventEnd, msg, durationCalcLogs))
	if len(durationCalcLogs): system.perspective.openPopup('intelligentScheduleLogs', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/loggingPopup', params={'popupId': 'intelligentScheduleLogs', 'logs': durationCalcLogs}, draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, title='Order Schedule Information')
		
	modeInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getModes({'modeName': 'Production'}),0)
	scheduleBlockInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.schedule.getScheduleBlocks({'scheduleBlockId': -1}), 0)	#Create empty scheduleBlock
	scheduleBlockInfo['assetPath'] = assetInfo['assetPath']
	scheduleBlockInfo['assetId'] = assetInfo['assetId']
	scheduleBlockInfo['workOrderId'] = woInfo['workOrderId']
	scheduleBlockInfo['itemId'] = woInfo['itemId']		
	scheduleBlockInfo['modeId'] = modeInfo['modeId']		
	scheduleBlockInfo['color'] = event['eventColor'] or itemInfo['itemColor'] or itemInfo['itemClassColor'] or modeInfo['modeColor']
	scheduleBlockInfo['scheduledQty'] = event['selectedQty']
	
	self.addEvent({'scheduleBlockInfo': scheduleBlockInfo, 'start': start, 'end': system.date.format(eventEnd)})
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', msg)

	#We'll update the work order status if necessary
	schedQty = (woInfo['schedQty'] or 0) + event['selectedQty']
	if woInfo['workOrderStatusName'] == 'Released' and schedQty >= woInfo['reqdQty']: 
		workOrderStatusId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('workOrderStatusId', system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrderStates({'workOrderStatusName': 'Scheduled'}))
		system.kanoa.order.updateProductionOrderField(woInfo['workOrderId'], 'workOrderStatusId', workOrderStatusId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshOrders', {})	#forces the order event selector to update itself
		self.refreshCalendarEvents({'refreshShifts': False, 'calledBy': 'addWorkOrder() msg'})
	
	return

customMethods.name: getShiftTimes
customMethods.script:
#	system.perspective.print("getShiftTimes() called with %s %s %s %s"%(assetPath, start, end, timezone))

	if assetPath is None: return {"daysOfWeek": [], "endTime": "24:00", "startTime": "00:00", "shiftData": []}
	startDate = system.date.parse(start)
	endDate = system.date.parse(end)
	
	tzOffsets = self.view.custom.timezones
	if not tzOffsets.has_key(timezone): return {"daysOfWeek": [], "endTime": "24:00", "startTime": "00:00", "shiftData": []}
	
	tzOffsetMins = tzOffsets[timezone]['startOffSetMins']
	rangeStart = system.date.addDays(system.date.addMinutes(startDate, tzOffsetMins), -1)
	rangeEnd = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, tzOffsetMins)
	
	paramsDict = {'startDate': rangeStart, 'endDate': rangeEnd, 'assetPath': assetPath, 'includeInherited': True, 'includeSubAssets': False, 'tzOffsets': tzOffsets}
	shiftData = system.kanoa.shift.getShiftCalendarEvents(paramsDict)
	self.view.custom.shiftData = shiftData

	if len(shiftData) == 0: return {"daysOfWeek": [0,1,2,3,4,5,6], "endTime": "24:00", "startTime": "00:00", "shiftData": shiftData}

	shiftDays = []
	startTime = 1440
	endTime = 0
	for row in shiftData:
		startDate = system.date.parse(row['start'])
		endDate = system.date.parse(row['end'])

		shiftDays.append(system.date.getDayOfWeek(startDate)-1)
		shiftDays.append(system.date.getDayOfWeek(system.date.addMinutes(endDate, -1))-1)		

		thisStartTime = system.date.getHour24(startDate) * 60 + system.date.getMinute(startDate)
		if thisStartTime < startTime: startTime = thisStartTime

		thisEndTime = system.date.getHour24(endDate) * 60 + system.date.getMinute(endDate)
		if thisEndTime == 0: endTime = 24 * 60
		if thisEndTime > endTime: endTime = thisEndTime

	shiftDays = sorted(list(set(shiftDays)))
	startTime = "%s:%s"%(str(startTime //60).zfill(2), str(startTime %60).zfill(2))
	endTime = "%s:%s"%(str(endTime //60).zfill(2), str(endTime %60).zfill(2))
	
	return {'daysOfWeek': shiftDays, 'startTime': startTime, 'endTime': endTime}
